description: Sass helps you write CSS with reusable names and recipes. A build tool turns your Sass into normal CSS. Start with a colour, then learn to share styles without copying the same lines. Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
versionNote: Uses Dart Sass and the SCSS syntax, with the modern @use module system.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to change the ink colour and rebuild the CSS file
Learn to include soft-box inside one more class named tip
Learn to change the lookup from sun to sea
